series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 8 important consumer trends for 2008
notes: December 2007 Trend Briefing. Labels are the numbered heading images' alt text. target_year 2008 from the title. The paid 2008 Trend Report is not captured.

entries.label: STATUS SPHERES
entries.quote: We've dubbed the above phenomenon STATUS SPHERES: a variety of lifestyles, activities and persuasions, which can be mixed and matched by consumers looking for recognition from various crowds and scenes.
entries.subject: Status beyond traditional consumption
entries.note: Spheres listed: traditional, transient, online, eco, giving, participative. Successor of 2007 STATUS LIFESTYLES (the text says so).

entries.label: PREMIUMIZATION
entries.quote: no industry, no sector, no product will escape a premium version in the next 12 months.
entries.subject: Premium versions of everyday products

entries.label: SNACK CULTURE
entries.quote: SNACK CULTURE, like PREMIUMIZATION, is not a 'new new ' trend, but definitely one that will continue to thrive next year.
entries.subject: Smaller, faster, temporary consumption units (snack packs, fast fashion, small cars)

entries.label: ONLINE OXYGEN
entries.quote: Five years ago, we introduced ONLINE OXYGEN as the engine behind all this excitement: control-craving consumers needing online access as much as they need oxygen.
entries.subject: Ubiquitous online access (mobile broadband, inflight internet)
entries.note: Recycled label: ONLINE OXYGEN was a 2003 monthly briefing. The section cites third-party mobile forecasts (about 3.3 billion mobile users in 2011; nearly 1 in 3 mobile subscribers on mobile broadband by 2012), not trendwatching's own numbers.

entries.label: ECO-ICONIC
entries.quote: Eco-friendly goods and services sporting bold, iconic design and markers, that help their eco-conscious owners to visibly tout their eco-credentials to peers.
entries.subject: Visibly eco-friendly products as status markers
entries.note: Quote is the edition's own definition, printed in quotation marks.

entries.label: BRAND BUTLERS
entries.quote: Instead of stalking potential and existing customers (which is not very 2008), why not assist them in smart, relevant ways, making the most of your products and whatever it is your brand stands for?
entries.subject: Brands offering useful services instead of advertising

entries.label: MIY | MAKE IT YOURSELF
entries.quote: In fact, expect MIY | MAKE IT YOURSELF (and then SIY | SELL IT YOURSELF) ventures to become increasingly sophisticated in the next 12 months:
entries.subject: Consumer-designed physical products (digital design to manufacturing)
entries.note: Quote ends with a colon in the source (it introduces examples).

entries.label: CROWD MINING
entries.quote: when co-creating, co-funding, co-buying, co-designing, co-managing *anything* with 'crowds', the emphasis in 2008 will move from just getting the masses in, to mining those crowds for the rough and polished diamonds.
entries.subject: Crowdsourcing that rewards the best contributors
